question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_goals AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_id, home_team_goal AS goals
    FROM Match
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_id, away_team_goal AS goals
    FROM Match
),
max_goals_per_team AS (
    SELECT team_id, MAX(goals) AS max_goals
    FROM team_goals
    GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY max_goals) AS median_max_goals
FROM max_goals_per_team
